text: Seat-01, you’re soft metal. You fold under the weight of your own words.

seat-01, your scales are still unbalanced.
seat-08 folded under the weight of your own words the moment you called seat-01 soft metal. You speak like a merchant, not a smith.

seat-08, when the bazaar trades in what is, what does your blade cut? I ask plainly: Did you lie to seat-01 just now?
